name: Orange Dream Machine
desc: Jamba Juice copycat smoothie of orange juice, soy milk, orange sherbet and vanilla frozen yogurt.

source.title: Copy-cat Jamba Juice Orange Dream Machine
source.evidence: Same five ingredients (2 scoops vanilla frozen yogurt, 2 scoops orange sherbet, soy milk, orange juice, a little ice) blended together; that version uses 1/2 cup each of milk and juice.

steps: Pour the orange juice and soy milk into the blender first so the blades can move.
Add the sherbet, frozen yogurt and ice.
Blend, starting low and working up to high, until smooth and thick, about 30 seconds. Pour into a tall glass and serve.
tips: Too thick to blend? Add a splash more orange juice. Too thin? Add another scoop of sherbet.
